name: Discord Webform Handler
description: A Webform handler plugin that posts each submission to a configured Discord webhook.
project_description:
The "Discord Webform Handler" module is designed to send webform submission data to a specified Discord channel via a webhook. This module adds a new webform handler plugin that allows you to configure a Discord webhook URL for each webform. When a webform is submitted, the submission data is posted to the configured Discord webhook, allowing you to receive real-time updates in your Discord channel.

 How to Generate a Discord Webhook:

 
 
 Open Discord and go to the channel where you want to receive the webform submission data. 
 Click on the gear icon next to the channel name to open the channel settings. 
 Go to the "Integrations" section. 
 Click on the "Create Webhook" button. 
 Customize the webhook's name, avatar, and channel. The channel should be the one where you want to receive the webform submission data. 
 Click on the "Copy Webhook URL" button to copy the webhook URL. 
 Click on the "Save" button to create the webhook. 
 Paste the copied webhook URL into the "Discord Webhook URL" field of the "Discord Webform Handler" in your webform settings in Drupal. 
 
 Now, whenever the webform is submitted, the submission data will be posted to your Discord channel.
